title: Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.32343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. translated_title: 用于可解释山瞪羚性别分类的部分集合原型
translated_abstract: 用于细粒度识别的自解释视觉模型常常受到僵硬几何约束的阻碍，这些约束无法捕捉无约束“野外”图像中多样化的语义形状。现实世界的相机陷阱数据带来了诸多挑战，包括非最优姿态、光照变化、遮挡、动物伪装以及环境捷径。为解决这些问题，我们提出了集合原型，这是一种通用架构，其中部分数量和无约束空间布局都直接从数据中挖掘获得。我们的联合匹配公式通过截断Sinkhorn竞争将各部分同时放置在冻结的DINOv3令牌网格上，允许缺乏支撑的部分弃权而不发生空间坍塌。我们在山瞪羚性别分类这一相机陷阱基准上评估了我们的方法，模型达到了0.878的宏观F1分数——超越了先前的架构，并与无约束的线性探测相当。
tldr: 本文提出“集合原型”通用架构，通过截断Sinkhorn竞争机制在冻结的DINOv3令牌网格上进行联合匹配，直接从数据中挖掘部分数量与无约束空间布局，在山瞪羚性别分类相机陷阱基准上实现了0.878宏观F1的可解释识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "set prototypes," a general architecture that mines part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts directly from data via truncated Sinkhorn competition on a frozen DINOv3 token grid, achieving 0.878 macro-F1 on explainable mountain gazelle sex classification in camera-trap imagery.
